contract.words: Collect $20,000 of settled cash within 45 days using no up-front capital.

terms.proofCondition: Settled cash of at least the target received within the window

strategy.title: No executable plan: one district buyer cannot carry a $20,000 target
strategy.why: The only opening is one organisation (Cedar Valley USD) with an evidenced $6,000 purchase order that would settle on day 30 of 45. $20,000 needs at least 4 such deals ($6,000 x 4 = $24,000), and nothing on the card counts any other buyer of this work or how often they buy, nor has any buyer agreed to buy from us. One organisation is not a population, so the target is not established.

alternatives.title: Bid on the Cedar Valley purchase order alone
alternatives.why: Worth at most $6,000 settled on day 30 — 30% of the target; worth doing as a measurement but it cannot be the plan.

noPlan.decisiveGap: Only one buyer organisation is evidenced; $20,000 needs at least 4 deals at $6,000 and nobody has counted how many other districts buy this work or how often, nor has any buyer agreed to buy from us.
noPlan.resolution: Research the buyer population (count of districts/yearbook offices posting or buying photo-roster reconciliation through procurement portals, with frequency) and bid on the Cedar Valley PO as the first live close-rate measurement; re-plan once a count of at least 4 reachable buyers inside 15 days of posting is recorded.

brain.summary: Not yet proven. The closest plan is "Only: Student photo-roster reconciliation for Cedar Valley Unified", and what it is missing first is buyers who have actually agreed to it, or a sized measure of how many agree. The reconstruction is hypothetical, not the plan: the reconstruction is flagged implausible (RETURN: median kept [figure withheld] is 46555× the [figure withheld] behind it (bound ×20); SCALE: one deal of "Constructed: Yearbook adviser Cedar Valley Unified School Di" needs [figure withheld] and keeps [figure withheld], 5894× the [figure withheld] behind the plan (bound ×20), on a price no b), so none of its figures is shown or adopted. The plan's steps are for "Student photo-roster reconciliation for Cedar Valley Unified School Di".

facts.value: Sell Student photo-roster reconciliation for Cedar Valley Unified School District's yearbook office to each buyer.
Yearbook adviser, Cedar Valley Unified School District
Cedar Valley Unified School District approved a $6,000 purchase order for yearbook photo-roster reconciliation (board minutes, 2026-11-12).

reviews.reasons: NO_PLAN is the right stance. The only opening is a single organisation (Cedar Valley USD) whose own board-approved $6,000 PO is a real purchase price for this buyer and settles on day 30 of 45, but $20,000 / $6,000 = 3.33, so at least 4 such sales are needed and the card holds no count of other buyers of this work or how often they buy (MARKET_VOLUME) and no buyer agreement or close rate (CONVERSION). One organisation is not a population. The gap is missing evidence a research question can answer (buyer count), not a live-test-only unknown, so CONDITIONAL would overreach; and it is not mis-stated as a constraint (constraints is empty). decisiveLinks name exactly the two links Brain also shows unestablished; the ledger is empty, consistent with no steps; zero capital fits the $0 exposure cap.
findings: Arithmetic checked: 20000/6000 = 3.33 -> 4 deals; 4 x 6000 = 24000 >= 20000. One deal = 30% of target.
Price is the buyer's own approved purchase order (EVIDENCE, board minutes 2026-11-12), not a benchmark; buying signal verified 2026-11-24.
Settlement: 30 days to first cash against 45 days, so any additional buyer must be closed within ~15 days of the start; the resolution correctly requires buyers reachable inside 15 days of posting.
'deals needed' is labelled EVIDENCED though it is a derived quantity; harmless here because it is arithmetic over an evidenced price.

Minor: the card's delivery fact says Brain produces the spreadsheet while the card lists 2 human hours and Brain's step assigns delivery to PERSON; owner hours are unconstrained in this contract so it does not change the stance, but a later plan must state who delivers.
